_readme: The 50-bug expansion. Java (BugSpecies) mirrors these ids, animation names, glow and translucency exactly. 'px' is the rough length of the model in Blockbench pixels before the in-game render 'scale'. 'anims' must exist with exactly these names (animation.<id>.<name>). 'group' says which modelling batch owns the bug.

bugs.name: Worker Ant
bugs.look: Glossy red-brown ant: round head with mandibles, narrow thorax, pinched waist node, round gaster; elbowed antennae; six long thin legs.
bugs.mechanic: Marches in follow-the-leader columns and tends aphids.

bugs.name: Earwig
bugs.look: Long flat glossy dark brown body, short orange-tan wing covers, big curved rear forceps (two bones so they can open/close), short legs, beaded antennae.
bugs.mechanic: Hates light: scuttles to the darkest nearby spot. 'pinch' snaps the forceps.

bugs.name: Termite
bugs.look: Pale cream soft segmented body, orange-brown head with dark mandibles, straight beaded antennae, short legs.
bugs.mechanic: Eats dropped wooden items (sticks, saplings, planks, logs) and turns them into frass.

bugs.name: Millipede
bugs.look: Long cylindrical glossy black body of ~10 segments, each with an orange-red side stripe; two pairs of tiny orange legs per segment (use thin plane legs). 'curl' (played and held) coils the body into a spiral: make each segment its own chained bone so it can curl.
bugs.mechanic: Curls up when threatened; poisons anyone who hits it bare-handed.

bugs.name: Caddisfly Larva
bugs.look: A tube-shaped case built from pebbles and sand grains (grey/brown speckled, px detail), with the pale larva's dark head and three pairs of legs poking out of the front.
bugs.mechanic: Lives underwater on stream beds.

bugs.name: Orb Weaver
bugs.look: Garden spider: big round abdomen with yellow-and-black banded pattern, small dark cephalothorax, 8 long legs banded black/yellow, tiny spinnerets.
bugs.mechanic: Spins real cobwebs near trees and fences at dusk and eats flying bugs caught in them.

bugs.name: Tick
bugs.look: Tiny flat teardrop-oval red-brown tick with a dark shield plate at the front, protruding mouthparts, 8 short legs.
bugs.mechanic: Hitches rides on passing animals.

bugs.name: Centipede
bugs.look: Long flat red-brown centipede, ~12 segments each with one pair of long yellow-orange legs, long antennae, front poison claws (forcipules), two long rear legs.
bugs.mechanic: Hunts silverfish and endermites.

bugs.name: Jumping Spider
bugs.look: Fuzzy black body with white spots and a white band, huge glossy front eyes (two big, two small) with a white shine pixel, iridescent teal chelicerae, 8 short thick legs (front pair bigger). 'dance' raises and waves the front legs.
bugs.mechanic: Watches you; pounces on small bugs; dances when you hold something shiny.

bugs.name: Honeypot Ant
bugs.look: Ant with an enormous swollen translucent-amber golden abdomen (a bulging honey balloon with thin dark bands), small dark head and thorax, thin legs.
bugs.mechanic: Milk it with a glass bottle for honey.

bugs.name: Antlion
bugs.look: Squat sandy-grey larva with a round bristly abdomen, small flat head and huge sickle-shaped jaws (two bones). 'grab' snaps the jaws shut.
bugs.mechanic: Lies buried in sand and grabs whatever steps on it.

bugs.name: Bookworm
bugs.look: Whimsical booklouse: tiny pale beige segmented body, big round head wearing tiny round dark spectacles (black ring px), little antennae.
bugs.mechanic: Lives beside bookshelves and makes paper.

bugs.name: Scorpion
bugs.look: Amber-tan scorpion: two big pincers on arms, flat segmented body, segmented tail (chained bones) curled up over the back ending in a dark stinger, 8 legs. Glow: whole body is glow='c2'-ish pale cyan fluorescence (use glow=True on the body cubes with a pale cyan tint colour in the glowmask - the game shows it only at night).
bugs.mechanic: Fluoresces at night; stings attackers with poison.

bugs.name: Tarantula
bugs.look: Big hairy dark brown-black tarantula (high noise), orange bands at the knees, fuzzy round abdomen, 8 thick two-segment legs, small eye cluster.
bugs.mechanic: Tameable pet that follows you.

bugs.name: Ice Crawler
bugs.look: Pale icy-blue wingless insect (grylloblattid), slightly translucent frosty body, long thin antennae, two long rear cerci, long legs.
bugs.mechanic: Needs cold: overheats in warm places.

bugs.name: Giant Isopod
bugs.look: Big pale lilac-grey armoured isopod: ~7 overlapping plates (chained bones), big black compound eyes, long antennae, fan-shaped tail, 7 pairs of short legs. 'curl' (held) rolls up.
bugs.mechanic: Crawls the deep ocean floor.

bugs.name: Queen Ant
bugs.look: Large regal ant, dark red-brown with gold markings, long elongated gaster, translucent folded wings on the back, a tiny gold crown-like crest on the head.
bugs.mechanic: Worker ants follow her; with workers in a terrarium she doubles their output.

bugs.name: Mayfly
bugs.look: Delicate pale yellow slender body curving upward at the tail, three very long thin tail filaments, big upright clear triangular wings held together vertically over the back at rest, tiny hindwings.
bugs.mechanic: Lives only a few minutes before vanishing.

bugs.name: Mosquito
bugs.look: Thin dark body with white stripes, long proboscis, long thin legs dangling, narrow clear wings. The abdomen is its own bone; 'fed' (looped) swells it (scale ~1.8) and it should look red (make a hidden red abdomen overlay bone that 'fed' scales up from 0).
bugs.mechanic: Bites players at night, then flies off full.

bugs.name: Cicada
bugs.look: Stout greenish-black body, wide head with big wide-set red eyes, clear green-veined wings held tent-like over the back. 'buzz' vibrates the abdomen and wings rapidly.
bugs.mechanic: Clings to acacia trunks, shrills in the heat and sheds its old skin.

bugs.name: Katydid
bugs.look: Leaf-green bush cricket whose forewings look exactly like a leaf (midrib and vein px), extremely long thin antennae (longer than the body), long hind legs. 'sing' rubs the wings.
bugs.mechanic: Answers note blocks: sings back the same note and comes to it.

bugs.name: Hummingbird Hawk-Moth
bugs.look: Fat furry grey-brown body with a black-and-white tufted tail fan, grey forewings, orange hindwings, a long uncoiled proboscis pointing forward; 'fly' is a very fast blur flap (period ~0.06).
bugs.mechanic: Hovers at flowers like a hummingbird.

bugs.name: Sakura Moth
bugs.look: Pale pink fluffy moth, wings patterned like cherry blossoms (white-pink petals with deeper pink centres, hand-drawn grid), pink feathery antennae, white fur collar.
bugs.mechanic: Scatters pink petals in cherry groves.

bugs.name: Paper Wasp
bugs.look: Slender yellow-and-black banded wasp with a narrow waist, long dangling orange legs, smoky translucent wings, curled orange antennae, stinger.
bugs.mechanic: Territorial: strike one and its neighbours swarm you.

bugs.name: Locust
bugs.look: Desert locust: yellow-brown speckled grasshopper body, long mottled brown forewings, pink-red hindwings visible in flight, big hind legs.
bugs.mechanic: Travels in flocking swarms.

bugs.name: Luna Moth
bugs.look: Pale mint-green moth with long curling tail streamers on the hindwings, small yellow-and-purple eyespots, a purple-brown leading edge on the forewings, white fuzzy body. Faint glow: glowmask the eyespots and a soft green on the wings (glow='c2' patterns).
bugs.mechanic: Appears only on full-moon nights.

bugs.name: Blue Morpho
bugs.look: Butterfly with electric iridescent blue upper wings and black borders (glow on the blue), brown undersides with a row of eyespots (down faces).
bugs.mechanic: Flashes brilliant blue with every wingbeat.

bugs.name: Owl Butterfly
bugs.look: Large brown butterfly; underside of the hindwings has a huge owl-eye spot (yellow ring, black centre, white glint) - put it on the down faces and on the up faces too so it reads from above; forewings tan with wavy lines.
bugs.mechanic: Its owl eyes keep phantoms away.

bugs.name: Atlas Moth
bugs.look: Gigantic moth: rusty red-brown wings with white triangular 'windows', pale bands, and forewing tips shaped like snake heads (yellow with a black eye spot). Feathery antennae, furry body.
bugs.mechanic: Has no mouth: cannot be fed or bred.

bugs.name: Soul Moth
bugs.look: Dark soul-sand brown moth whose wing edges burn with cyan-blue soul flame (glow='c2' on flame pixels, flickering patches), glowing cyan eyes.
bugs.mechanic: Drawn to soul fire and soul lanterns.

bugs.name: Gust Moth
bugs.look: Breeze-themed: pale teal-white translucent wings with swirl patterns, a body of stacked rings like a breeze rod. 'gust' snaps the wings forward hard.
bugs.mechanic: Blasts players back with a gust of wind.

bugs.name: Shulker Mite
bugs.look: Round mite living in a tiny shulker-shell carapace: two purpur-lavender shell halves (top/bottom bones) that open a crack showing a yellow-green glowing body (glow) with tiny legs; 'fly' bobs and lifts the lid.
bugs.mechanic: Floats and gives Levitation to anyone it touches.

bugs.name: Echo Moth
bugs.look: Deep-dark teal-black moth; antennae are sculk-sensor tendrils; wings carry concentric sound-wave rings (glow='c2' cyan rings).
bugs.mechanic: Silences vibrations around it - sculk and wardens cannot hear you near it.

bugs.name: Grasshopper
bugs.look: Bright grass-green grasshopper with a yellow belly, short antennae, big muscular hind legs (bigger than the cricket's), folded wings, big eyes.
bugs.mechanic: Leaps away in huge bounds when you come near.

bugs.name: Springtail
bugs.look: Tiny plump blue-grey/lavender bug (snow flea) with a forked tail spring folded under the abdomen, short antennae; 'hop' flicks the fork down.
bugs.mechanic: Catapults itself with its tail spring.

bugs.name: Whirligig Beetle
bugs.look: Glossy black oval beetle with a bronze iridescent sheen (iri), eyes split into top and bottom halves, short paddle legs.
bugs.mechanic: Spins in tight circles on the water surface.

bugs.name: Stink Bug
bugs.look: Shield-shaped brown-grey marbled bug (spots), a triangle scutellum plate on the back, banded antennae, short legs.
bugs.mechanic: Releases a nauseating stink cloud when threatened.

bugs.name: Praying Mantis
bugs.look: Green mantis: long thin thorax raised upright, triangular head with big eyes, folded raptorial front legs (bones so 'strike' can snap them forward), long abdomen with folded wings, 4 thin walking legs.
bugs.mechanic: Ambushes and eats small bugs that come close.

bugs.name: Bombardier Beetle
bugs.look: Orange head and thorax, dark blue-black elytra with yellow markings, orange legs; 'spray' lifts and swings the abdomen tip.
bugs.mechanic: Sprays boiling chemicals that set attackers alight.

bugs.name: Diving Beetle
bugs.look: Streamlined olive-black oval beetle with a yellow margin, flattened oar-like fringed hind legs; 'walk' is a swimming stroke of the hind legs.
bugs.mechanic: Swims underwater.

bugs.name: Mole Cricket
bugs.look: Velvety brown cylindrical cricket with huge shovel-like front legs, short wings, small eyes; 'dig' scoops with the front legs.
bugs.mechanic: Burrows through dirt and pops up somewhere else.

bugs.name: Darkling Beetle
bugs.look: Matte black domed beetle with bumpy ridges and long legs; 'bask' (looped) raises the rear high with the head down, with a few water-drop pixels on the back.
bugs.mechanic: Fog-basks at dawn, collecting water.

bugs.name: Leaf Insect
bugs.look: Flat broad leaf-green body shaped like a leaf with a midrib and side veins (px), leafy flaps on the legs, small head, sways gently in idle.
bugs.mechanic: Invisible while still - unless you look through a spyglass.

bugs.name: Click Beetle
bugs.look: Elongated dark brown beetle; the pronotum has two glowing green 'headlight' spots (glow px). 'click' jack-knifes the body at the thorax.
bugs.mechanic: Flips into the air with a loud click to escape.

bugs.name: Sea Skater
bugs.look: Tiny round silver-grey ocean strider with a silver sheen, long middle and hind legs, short front legs.
bugs.mechanic: The only insect of the open ocean.

bugs.name: Mushroom Beetle
bugs.look: Pleasing fungus beetle: glossy orange-red elytra with two black bands, black head and legs, and a tiny red-capped mushroom sprouting from its back.
bugs.mechanic: Plants little mushrooms on mycelium.

bugs.name: Rain Beetle
bugs.look: Furry chestnut beetle with golden hair (high noise), fan-shaped lamellate antennae that open.
bugs.mechanic: Comes up out of the ground only while it rains.

bugs.name: Chorus Weevil
bugs.look: Lavender-purple weevil with a very long down-curved snout (antennae on the snout), bumpy chorus-fruit textured elytra.
bugs.mechanic: Commutes between chorus plants by teleporting.

bugs.name: Storm Beetle
bugs.look: Dark slate beetle with electric yellow lightning-bolt patterns on the elytra (glow px), copper-green horn and antenna tips; 'charge' (looped) raises the elytra and vibrates.
bugs.mechanic: Appears only in thunderstorms and calls down lightning.

bugs.name: Crystal Beetle
bugs.look: A beetle made of crystal: faceted translucent amethyst/diamond elytra (alpha ~0.7, iri purple->cyan) with white prismatic highlight pixels (glow), dark crystal legs.
bugs.mechanic: Found in End cities; its shell grows gems.
